name: How long does it take to repair water damage inside a house?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair water damage inside a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most jobs are fastest when moisture is caught early, but the timeline depends on how much water entered and how deep it spread. Small interior repairs may finish in a few days, while repairs involving soaked drywall, flooring, or hidden moisture can take longer because materials must dry before rebuilding starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small repairs may take a few days, but larger damage can take longer because drying must happen before rebuilding starts.
